items.text: A new water connection costs 450 euros. Applications use Form UT-200 and take 6 weeks to complete.

items.label: E2
items.text: A disputed meter reading must be reported within 30 days of the bill with Form UT-310.

items.label: E3
items.text: Households apply with Form UT-120 and a current benefit letter. Hardship applications are decided within 15 working days.

items.label: E4
items.text: Pensioners apply with Form UT-150 and proof of age. Pensioner applications are decided within 20 working days.

items.label: E5
items.text: Customers can request a payment plan of up to 12 months at the UCC.
